description.name: Entry
description.text: Twenty single attacks (0.01 each), grants [High Retaliate], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Gilgamesh], [Big Bridge Battle Ability Tracker] and [Big Bridge Battle Level]

description.name: High Retaliate
description.text: Evades PHY attacks, counters PHY attacks with an ability (PHY: single, 1.20 physical)

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Gilgamesh
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Big Bridge Battle (0~2), removed after using Big Bridge Battle two times

description.name: Big Bridge Battle Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Big Bridge Battle level by 1 after using 5 or 8 Fire abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Gilgamesh]

description.name: Big Bridge Battle Level
description.text: Keeps track of Big Bridge Battle level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Gilgamesh]
